reports.title: Establishment Labs® Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Based on third-quarter performance and its current outlook, Establishment Labs updated its full-year 2026 expectations:
•Increasing revenue to more than $274 million, compared to the previous guidance of $269 million to $271 million.
•Adjusted Gross Margin of approximately 70.7%, reflecting a higher-than-anticipated mix of OUS distributor sales.
•Adjusted Operating Expenses of $195 million to $200 million, unchanged.
